metadata.description: AWS cloud plugins for Claude Code — content creation and infrastructure operations

plugins.name: aws-content-plugin
plugins.description: AWS cloud content creation — presentations, architecture diagrams, animated diagrams, documents, GitBook sites, workshops, and brochures

plugins.name: aws-ops-plugin
plugins.description: AWS/EKS infrastructure operations — troubleshooting, networking, IAM, observability, storage, database, and cost optimization

plugins.name: kiro-power-converter
plugins.description: Convert Claude Code plugins to Kiro Power format — supports GitHub URL, local path, marketplace name, and individual skill conversion

plugins.name: co-agent
plugins.description: Collaborate with other AI agents (Kiro CLI and the opposite host CLI) — multi-AI code/architecture review, decision support when you're unsure, ADR co-authoring, and autonomous consensus/harness implementation pipelines. Claude chairs in Claude Code; Codex chairs in Codex.

plugins.name: agentcore-creator
plugins.description: Convert Claude Code plugins to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — config-only harness (skills attach unchanged) or Runtime agents, Gateway tools, Memory knowledge stores, Lambda functions

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Initialize and maintain Claude Code project structures with adaptive project detection, CLAUDE.md quality scoring, and auto-sync documentation workflows

plugins.name: kiro
plugins.description: Cost-savings delegation — Claude plans and verifies, Kiro CLI implements and reviews on its own flat-rate subscription credits, inside an isolated git worktree with a scope-guarded diff and a pre-commit review gate

plugins.name: token-saver
plugins.description: Concise responses with full reasoning, verification and complete deliverables.

plugins.name: pr-dash
plugins.description: Pull request CI and AI review status in a Claude Code pane, with a read-only text skill for Codex.
